agreed.text: You will start thyroid replacement medication.
You will take the medication every morning around 7:30–8:00 am on an empty stomach.
You will pick up the prescription the doctor sends next time you are at the clinic.
You will watch for a very fast heartbeat or feeling very anxious while on the tablets and seek urgent help if these happen.
You will have a follow-up in three months to see how the medication has helped.
